details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: local privilege escalation via the cifs.upcall
     getpwuid() lookup in the caller-controlled namespace
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-12505.patch: in cifs.upcall.c, drop
       supplementary groups before decoding the spnego key, call getpwuid()
       while still on the host namespace instead of after
       switch_to_process_ns(), and translate the host UID/GID to the target
       user namespace by parsing /proc/<pid>/{uid,gid}_map numerically.
     - CVE-2026-12505
